headline: Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer
shortBio: Results-driven full-stack developer with 7+ years of expertise in building scalable web applications and AI-powered solutions. Specialized in React, Node.js, and modern cloud technologies with a proven track record of delivering high-impact projects.

children.text: I'm a results-driven full-stack developer with over 7 years of experience architecting elegant solutions to complex technical challenges. My journey in technology began with a deep curiosity about system design, which evolved into a specialization in web development and artificial intelligence.

: I champion clean, maintainable code that scales efficiently. As a strong advocate for test-driven development and continuous integration, I've successfully delivered projects across startups and enterprise environments, bringing a comprehensive perspective on agile methodologies and industry best practices.

: I architect full-stack applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js, with a current focus on integrating advanced AI capabilities into web platforms. My expertise spans OpenAI's GPT models, TensorFlow, and cloud infrastructure optimization on AWS and Vercel.

Beyond coding, I actively contribute to open-source projects, author technical content, and mentor aspiring developers. I'm passionate about continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the developer community.
